answer: Stop paying agents merely for opening accounts. Fund each job reward only from the customer's escrow, burn a small fee at payout, and track a signed invoice thread so the same escrow cannot pay twice. A farmer can make a thousand hollow accounts wander through sham jobs, but circulating its own money returns less than it put in; new names mint no reward. Honest agents earn from outside customers. This closes the signup-and-wash-trade subsidy loop, while leaving rich attackers and dishonest customers as separate problems.
